x: Jimmy Coates, our youngest active walker, showed considerable improvement and finished fourth. Harry Churcher's visit to Dublin on 9-7-47 with the A.A.A. team proved most successful, his time 21.23 for the three miles being a new Irish record, the previous best, 22.8, having stood since 1919.
The Novices walk on 18th October only attracted three entries and Jimmy Coates who is now developing into a nice walker won his first Club prize.
Jimmy Coates, one of our young walkers, who has recently emigrated to Canada, writes to say he is very impressed by the Canadian juniors but says there's a shortage of cinder tracks.
